digest.component_or_area: autodeploy observability and disk pressure handling
propositions: AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE journal marker emitted by autodeploy.sh is not published to CloudWatch by observability.sh, unlike all other autodeploy markers (AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED, AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT, AUTODEPLOY_ERROR)
lack of disk_pressure_prunes metric prevents distinguishing whether reclaim gate ran and reclaimed nothing versus did not run at all during root-disk incidents
observability.sh publish_autodeploy_marker_delta helper can be reused to wire AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE marker to dimensionless disk_pressure_prunes metric with record-anchored ERE
disk_pressure_prunes counter must seed to 0 on first run and track deltas on subsequent runs, matching behavior of existing marker counters
runbook must document that disk_pressure_prunes counter distinguishes gate-did-not-run from gate-ran-and-reclaimed-nothing for incident diagnosis
